== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and later English Errata articles for [[Kessel (Dark)]]. Do not transclude onto Japanese, Unlimited, Two-Player, foil, or (V) articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per real Errata face; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]]. Locations use Light Side and Dark Side rows when both exist.
